laws.rule: Fukuoka Prefecture's accommodation tax is JPY 200 a person a night (about A$1.80, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) outside Kitakyushu and Fukuoka cities; Kitakyushu totals JPY 200; Fukuoka City totals JPY 200 under JPY 20,000 and JPY 500 from JPY 20,000.

laws.rule: Kitakyushu City bans smoking in public places in two designated zones, the Kokura central district and the Kurosaki sub-central district. A person who breaks the ban faces an administrative fine (karyō) of JPY 1,000 (about A$9.02, RBA rate of 30 October 2026). The city says heated tobacco is not yet treated as smoking under this ordinance, so it issues no fines for it.

Fukuoka City has amended its ordinance for the street no-smoking areas (Tenjin and Ohori, and around Hakata Station) so that it bans all smoking, not only walking while smoking, on roads, in parks and in plazas, and it now includes heated tobacco. The city's page says the start date will be announced once decided and gives no fine on that page, so check the city page before relying on the old walking-smoking rule. Private land is outside the ordinance.
